answer: If two karst caves echo the same fable at payout, both belong to one operator. Every identity records one fable in a karst cave at registration, anchoring it with a ferrous token backed by a 700,000 POA stake. A matching echo burns both rewards, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 600,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 1,300,000 POA, and three fakes cost 3,900,000 POA before any payout clears.
